title: 璐璐 · 皮克斯的花盆
description: 紫色尖帽的璐璐和小仙灵皮克斯一起照看花盆，帽尖弯成可爱的弧线。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayons with broken edges, scribbled fill and visible warm paper tooth
art_direction.palette: lavender, plum purple, sage green, peach, cream
art_direction.composition: Lulu from League of Legends, a recognizable tiny adult yordle enchantress with softly purple skin, large expressive green eyes, purple hair and her oversized tall floppy purple pointed hat. The hat curls in one playful soft arc and fits entirely inside the square. Fully clothed in a lilac long-sleeved tunic dress, dark purple leggings and chunky rounded little shoes; warm friendly smiling face. She stands on the floor beside a short wooden gardening table and turns a small flowerpot toward her friendly fairy Pix. Pix is a tiny simple glowing winged purple companion hovering near a blooming peach flower; a round face, two clearly separated wings, gentle appearance. Two more small pots and a little green leaf make a tidy scene. No staff, weapons, shapeshifting, chaos or frightening magic. Original full-body three-quarter layout with paper margins. Thick purple and sage wax strokes and peach flower accents.
